name: Labels
description: Prints labels for entries from the browser: name, kind and up to three fields (IP address, host name, serial number, model, manufacturer, MAC address, asset tag, inventory number) next to a QR code that the Phoedox app recognises when scanning. The QR code holds the web address https://<instance>/e/<project>/<entry> or the app link phx://e/<project>/<entry>. Sizes: Brother QL 62 mm continuous tape (cut at 29 mm), Dymo 54 × 25 mm (11352) and Dymo 89 × 36 mm (99012); printing uses the browser's print dialog with the label size, so choose the label printer, no margins and 100 % scale there. Shown on entries of physical kinds (devices, servers, network gear, racks, patch panels, outlets, rooms …). No settings, no backend and no network access: the QR code is generated in the browser; it only reads the entry that is open.
